_comment: The MANAGED BLOCK a real installer (a LATER stage's install/hooks.py, daemon-app-skeleton-spec.md §7) would idempotently write into ~/.claude/settings.json — never clobbering a user's existing hooks (this host already runs multiple hooks per event, capture-spec.md §5.1). Wire ONE mu-client-owned matcher entry per event onto scripts/hooks/mu_capture_once.sh (absolute path). Every event funnels through the SAME script -> `mu capture-once --host claude_code` (capture-spec.md §3): the hook JSON on stdin carries `hook_event_name` itself, so no per-event CLI flag is needed beyond --host.
